worldcombat.skill.iceball.summary: Curl into a ball of ice and push it straight along the current aim: every real hit freezes on another layer and the next ball is bigger and hits harder (up to 5), while a ball that sails past, breaks on a frame or has its damage refused shatters on the spot with no homing and no retry. The thicker the ball, the sooner it clips a narrow doorway. The caster stays rooted the whole time; the final shatter freezes a small patch of ground.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.0: Each real hit deals Ice damage: about %1$s on the first ball; one cast lands up to %2$s balls.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.1: Every landed ball multiplies the next by %1$s (capped at %2$s); the ball flies at %3$s blocks/tick, the first ball has a %4$s-block hitbox, each layer adds %5$s blocks and the ball grows to at most %6$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.2: The ball reaches %1$s blocks with %2$s s between balls; a miss or frame hit shatters it at the real contact, leaving up to %3$s slippery ice blocks that last %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.thick.on: Thick shell: each landed ball multiplies the next by 2.3, the power cap rises 15%, each layer adds 1.2x, the size cap rises 1.2x and the ice patch is larger and longer; costs 0.9x base power per ball, 0.85x ball speed, +2 ticks between balls, +2 ticks recovery and +6 ticks cooldown - bigger and heavier, but slower and dearer, and it clips narrow doorways sooner.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.thick.off: Thin shell (the native form): 2x per ball, 1.06x ball speed, -1 tick between balls and -4 ticks cooldown; at a lower power cap, no growth and a smaller, shorter ice patch - a faster ball thrown more often.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.growth.0: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s and the flight extends to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.growth.1: From level %1$s each pass rises to %2$s, the cap to %3$s, and the flight extends to %4$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.0: Push a string of ever-bigger ice balls along the aim
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.1: Freeze on another layer and hit harder each real hit
worldcombat.skill.iceball.use.2: Leave a patch of ice at the final contact
worldcombat.skill.iceball.preference.thi: On (thick): each landed ball multiplies by 2.3, the cap gains 15%, each layer adds 1.2x and the size cap rises 1.2x, and the ice patch is larger and longer, at 0.85x ball speed, +2 ticks between balls, +2 ticks recovery, +6 ticks cooldown and 0.9x base power per ball. Off (thin, the native form): 2x per ball, a faster ball and shorter interval and cooldown, at a lower cap, no growth and a smaller, shorter patch.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of throwing. Larger values open from further out.
world_combat.move.iceball.text.cap: Ice Ball landed %1$s passes and shattered
worldcombat.skill.iceball.description.st: While the ball is in flight the caster is held in place, unable to move or act otherwise. The direction is locked at release, so a target that falls or leaves does not recall a ball already sent; a miss, a frame hit or a refused hit shatters it on the spot, and it also ends once it has landed its full number of balls.
